mapper.select: select a.*, b.MODEL_ID as modelId,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as processInstanceId, b.SN as sn,b.STATUS as status from REG_CERT_STATUS_DATA a join APPLY_REG_CERT_DATA_FLOW b on a.APPLY_REG_FLW_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.ID_CARD_NUMBER = #{idCardNumber} and b.STATUS in ('1')
